gen-cabinet-grotesk-fs-bespoke-sans: Sturdy, unfussy letterforms up top, with curves that hold their thickness through every turn. Bespoke Sans follows in a sharp plain sans, its curve ends held well back from the stems.
gen-cabinet-grotesk-fs-gambetta: Gambetta reads like a bookish text serif, its heavier verticals tugging gently against lighter horizontals as the eye moves along. Cabinet Grotesk's ribbon-like, constant strokes make the sharpest foil.
gen-cabinet-grotesk-fs-karma: Wire-straight and striking, Cabinet Grotesk keeps its curves full right through the turns. It leads with that bold line, while Karma, a text serif, steadies the page with a gentle pinch.
gen-caveat-fs-bespoke-sans: Bespoke Sans reads sharp and refined, with generous gaps where each curve meets its stem, so the lines stay crisp. Caveat's pen-scrawled, tightly packed heading sits above it, made for brief reading.
gen-cinzel-decorative-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Cinzel Decorative sets widely spaced capitals that look ceremonial, and it handles that drama best. Be Vietnam Pro, a plain sans, does the quieter job, with round letters whose rims match their stems.
gen-cinzel-decorative-fs-paquito: Paquito reads confident and approachable, its lowercase standing nearly as tall as its capitals. Cinzel Decorative, with its commanding, widely spaced capitals and tall lowercase, brings the real grandeur to the pair.
gen-cinzel-decorative-sora: Grand capitals meet crisp geometry here. Cinzel Decorative has a shimmer of weight changes and tall lowercase, while Sora keeps its curves pressure-free, so a bigger heading over smaller text feels natural.
gen-cinzel-decorative-space-grotesk: Commanding Cinzel Decorative spreads out its capitals and swells gently from hairline to stem. But Space Grotesk, a plain sans, runs each glyph as one ribbon, and that unshifting line is the pair's real hook.
gen-clash-display-gf-bhutuka-expanded-on: Sharp, precise headlines meet rounded, wire-bent letters. And BhuTuka Expanded One, a text serif, slows the pace to a leisurely walk, which is where Clash Display's crisp precision gets its richest foil.
gen-clash-grotesk-fs-literata: Clash Grotesk draws every counter with one smooth, tube-like line, and Literata then brings in sturdy thin strokes. That serif settles into a gentle, bookish rhythm over a longer read.
